info.name: Karachi Central Library API
info.description:
Seed the database once (npm run db:seed). After that the collection can be run again and again: it creates its own book, member and requests and cleans them up.

Start the API with JWT_EXPIRES_IN=10s so the token-expiry step in the auth flow can pass.

One run uses about 55 of the API rate limit (RATE_LIMIT_MAX=100 per 15 minutes), so a second run straight away gets 429s: wait 15 minutes or raise the limit.
